people.imagined: Dawn at the frost pans in the paper yard. She stands in the steam deciding by the frost which girl may melt it today. Her fingers, wrapped in birch strips, are pink from the cold.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn among steaming pans, she looks over the viewer's shoulder with a stern, deciding stare, fingers wrapped in strips of pale bark. Face, most important: every finger of both hands bound in thin strips of white birch bark, frost-pink at the tips, held up near her chin. A broad, flushed, strong face of about forty-two; red-pink skin from steam; narrow hazel eyes; heavy straight brows with frost on them; a short nose; a firm mouth. Hair: brown, tied under a birch-bark hat with a rim, a few damp curls at the temples. Body: broad-shouldered, sturdy. Clothing: a clean undyed linen robe with ink-grey cuffs and a pale pine-green inner-gate sash; a thick pale apron; the birch-bark hat. Hands: wrapped fingers lifted, holding a long wooden paddle. Background: pale stone pans with white steam, rows of pressed paper hanging, frost on boards. Light: cold blue dawn from the upper left, warm steam glow. Qi: a faint pale-green frost haze. The birch-bark strips round her fingers are pale and curling at the edges, tied with thread, with the pink tips of frozen fingers showing; her voice is hoarse, the broad mouth set hard, and the steam from the stone pans rises past the frost-rimmed boards behind her while the sun slants low and blue over the yard. Expression: a stern, deciding stare with narrowed eyes and a firm, closed mouth, her breath misting in the steam.

people.imagined: He writes ward sheets by a window with a slow scribe's blink and a brush tucked in his belt like a sword. A young man beside him is drafting against a wall of ice; he lets him.
people.subject: The moment: at a writing table by a window he looks up with a slow, long blink, a long brush stuck through his belt at the hip like a sword; a young man beside him is drafting against a wall of ice, and he lets him. Face: most important, a long slim writing brush in a bamboo sleeve, tilted at the hip like a sheathed sword, and a slow, heavy-lidded blink showing pale lids with a faint blue vein. It is a calm, long, gentle face of thirty-eight, fair, with a faint ink smudge by the eye, dark kind eyes, thin level brows, a straight nose and a small warm smile. Hair: black, in a neat top bun tied with a pine-green cord. Body: tall, a little stooped and relaxed. Clothing: a clean, soft undyed linen robe with the cuffs ink-dark to the second knuckle, a pine-green inner-gate sash, and one sleeve tied back. Hands and objects: a slender brush in the right hand resting over a sheet of pale pine-resin paper with a blank space left on it; a faint green-blue hint of pine mist in the air. Background: a blurred window of pale shutters, stacked paper, a white paper lantern on the shelf, unlit, round as a moon. Light: soft overcast light from the upper left. Expression: compassionate and calm, patient, the slow smile of a scribe who has time for everyone.

people.imagined: A first-year girl in the paper yard with pulp-flecked face and fingertips cut by paper, hiding spoiled sheets under her mat to practise strokes on. She is looking up guiltily.
people.subject: The moment: at a pressing table, she freezes with a stack of spoiled sheets half hidden behind her back, looking up guiltily. Face, most important: a plain broad face thickly freckled with tiny flecks of pulp, and every fingertip with a thin red paper cut, held up. Age sixteen; pink skin; round small brown eyes; faint pale brows; a flat nose; a nervous half-smile. Hair: light brown, in a short plait tied with bark twine, bits of pulp in it. Body: stout, sturdy, shoulders hunched. Clothing: an undyed linen robe of clean plain cloth with the outer-gate pale grey sash, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a birch-bark hat hanging at her back. Hands: fingers cut and red, a sheet of damp paper pinched in one hand. Background: a blurred wet paper yard with hanging sheets. Light: pale cool light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green mist. The pulp flecks are tiny pale specks in her freckles, her red paper cuts are fine as hairs on every fingertip, and the spoiled sheets behind her back are crumpled grey and damp; the hanging sheets of paper in the yard behind her ripple like pale flags in the cool air. Expression: wide, guilty eyes lifted quickly with a nervous, tight smile and a flush across the pulp-flecked cheeks.

people.imagined: At the ink hut he grinds a stick of pine-soot ink, murmuring. Ash on his eyelashes turns them grey. He answers in a voice that barely carries.
people.subject: The moment: grinding ink in a stone hut, he looks up quietly, murmuring an answer too soft to hear, in a voice that barely carries. Face: most important, eyelashes and brows grey with kiln ash, as if powdered, and soot in every crease of his face. It is a thin, pale, quiet face of twenty, grained with black soot lines at the eyes and mouth, with dark eyes, thin brows, a small nose and a slight mouth. Hair: black and short, dusted grey with ash. Body: lean, patient and still. Clothing: a clean undyed linen robe, clean at the chest with ink-black cuffs, a pine-green inner-gate sash, and a leather bracer, cracked with use, on one wrist. Hands and objects: a smooth black pine-soot ink stick held against a stone slab hollowed with use; a faint green and ash-grey haze rises from the work. Background: a dim stone hut with the orange glow of a kiln door at his side as a bar of light, and drifting ash. Light: dim orange kiln light from the lower left, cool grey from the upper left, the ash on his lashes lying like frost. Expression: calm and reclusive, diligent, the quiet, withdrawn look of a boy whose murmur sits in his throat.

people.imagined: A north-shore orphan naps on the shore with the unlit lanterns across his knees, awake and grinning at the viewer. He wants to light them.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a pebbled shore with a bundle of unlit paper lanterns across his knees, he grins up at the viewer lazily, a pole at his shoulder. Face, most important: a wide grin full of broken, chipped teeth, and a thick callus pad rising on his shoulder under the lantern pole. A lean, cheeky, sunburnt face of seventeen; brown skin; bright narrow eyes; messy dark brows; a crooked nose; a cheerful mouth. Hair: black, cropped short and rough. Body: wiry, sprawled. Clothing: an undyed linen robe, clean but loosely tied, with the outer-gate grey sash; a shore-grey woven scarf at the neck. Hands: holding a large round white paper lantern with a green stripe. Background: a blurred grey lake and pale sky, a distant shore. Light: cool lake light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-green mist. The pole on his shoulder carries six round white lanterns with a thin green stripe, their paper unlit and dented, and the callus is a hard yellow pad where the pole rests; the lake behind is a flat pewter and the far shore a low line of pines, with a few smooth pebbles at his feet. Expression: a lazy, mischievous grin with half-lidded eyes and a bright glint of wanting.

people.imagined: A raft-village girl copying a ward line for line, with wet heels and a rope scar around one ankle, smiling when she is praised for it.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk, she copies a ward draft stroke for stroke and looks up with a bright, ambitious smile at being praised. Face, most important: a thick braided raft-rope worn as a bracelet around her left wrist, scarred skin showing beneath it, held up beside her face, and her wet black hair dripping at the ends onto her shoulders. A narrow, quick, tan face of twenty-one; sharp dark eyes; arched thin brows; a pointed nose; a smile that is ready to lie. Hair: black, in a high tail tied with river-reed cord, damp at the ends. Body: slim, lithe, perched forward. Clothing: an undyed linen robe, clean and sharply fitted, a pine-green inner-gate sash, sleeves tied back. Hands: a brush over a sheet in one hand, a second sheet beside it in the other. Background: a blurred writing room, a wet floor. Light: cool light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue water glint. The rope bracelet at her wrist is thick braided raft-hemp, dark with water, and the scar beneath it is a pale ring; her hair drips onto the shoulders of her robe, leaving dark spots, and the sheets in front of her carry the neat strokes of a half-copied ward in dark ink. Expression: a bright, eager smile with sparkling eyes and a tilted chin, pleased with the praise and already looking for the next.

people.imagined: A road-walker returns from the palace with permits rolled under his arm, never once let past the palace's paper store. He stands loyal and patient, calves strong.
people.subject: The moment: arriving at a gate after a long road, he stands straight with a bundle of rolled permits clamped under his arm, dust on his boots, patient. Face, most important: a thick roll of permits tied with cord clamped under his arm, and strong knotted calves visible at the lower frame edge. A narrow, earnest face of twenty-four; light brown skin, a little sunburnt; steady brown eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a closed mouth. Hair: black, tied in a topknot with a sweat band. Body: wiry, road-lean. Clothing: an undyed linen robe, clean and pale, cut short for walking with a pine-green sash, a pale birch-bark hat hanging at his back, a bundle strap crossing the chest. Hands: one hand on the strap, the other holding the permits. Background: a blurred road through pines. Light: afternoon light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green pine haze. The permits are about a dozen narrow scrolls tied with a green cord and clamped hard under his arm, the strap across his chest holds a flat bundle, and his road-lean calves are dusty to the knee; the pines behind him are tall and the afternoon sun draws long gold lines across the track. Expression: a patient, steady face with weary but level eyes, dust on his brow and a cautious set to the mouth.

people.imagined: The head walks in daylight carrying a paper lantern out of habit, a quiet round-shouldered man with ink to the second knuckle. He has promised a lantern in every village before the thaw.
people.subject: The moment: standing in clear daylight, he holds an unlit paper lantern by its wooden stem out of habit and looks mildly at the viewer; he has promised a lantern in every village before the thaw. Face: most important, a round white paper lantern held up by its wooden stem in daylight, and both hands black with ink to the second knuckle. It is a quiet, soft, round face of about fifty, fair, with kind tired dark eyes, thin brows, a small nose and a gentle closed smile. Hair: black with grey at the temples, in a plain topknot. Body: round-shouldered and soft, not tall. Clothing: a fine undyed linen robe, clean and plain, with a dark green head's sash and a pale grey over-robe; the cuffs darkened with ink. Hands and objects: the lantern in one hand, its paper white and a little yellowed with a thin green stripe, the stem notched where his thumb sits; the other hand holds a slim ink brush with a split tip; a faint pale-green tint in the air. Background: a blurred pine forest and a lake shore, a thin grey line under the pine-dark hills. Light: clear daylight from the upper left. Expression: compassionate and humble, diligent, a gentle, tired kindness in the eyes and the closed smile.

people.imagined: The paper-mistress sniffs a sheet and names its maker. Her hands are stained with resin, a birch-bark hat on her head. She is thinking of the bark price and of old debts.
people.subject: The moment: in the paper yard she holds a sheet of resin paper to her nose and sniffs, then looks up with a stubborn, sharp stare, naming its maker; she is thinking of the price of bark and of old debts. Face: most important, a broad birch-bark hat with a wide flat rim and a chin-string of twisted bark, above resin-stained brown hands holding the sheet to her nose. She appears about fifty-five, with a tall, strong, long face, tanned and lined, sharp hazel eyes, thick grey brows, a long nose and a hard mouth. Hair: grey, in a heavy bun under the hat. Body: tall, long-armed and upright. Clothing: a clean undyed linen robe with an elder's grey-green sash and a dark resin-stained apron, the sleeves pushed to the elbow. Hands and objects: the thin, mottled gold sheet of pale resin paper pressed to her face with brown, sticky hands; a faint green resin-coloured haze in the air. Background: hanging sheets of paper in rows like pale curtains, and a stone press in a corner with its screw handle. Light: pale cool light from the upper left. Expression: stubborn and diligent, a hard, greedy shrewdness in the narrowed eyes, the look of a woman who knows what a sheet is worth before she has finished smelling it.

people.imagined: The lantern-walker, mid-journey, wears a different village's scarf this week and shoulders a pole of unlit lanterns. He has just drunk for free in a village.
people.subject: The moment: on a lake shore road, he swings a long pole of unlit paper lanterns over his shoulder and grins with a flushed face, a little drunk. Face, most important: a different village's bright patterned scarf wrapped at his neck, and a long pole carrying six round white lanterns on one shoulder. A long, lean, ruddy face of about sixty-five; weathered skin; merry pale blue eyes with a red edge; bushy brows; a big nose; a loose grin. Hair: grey, long, tied back in a tail with a coloured string. Body: long-legged, lanky, loose. Clothing: a clean sturdy undyed linen travelling coat, sleeves rolled, with a fish-leather belt and a bark hat at his back. Hands: one on the pole, the other holding a clay cup. Background: a blurred lake shore with fishing huts. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-green water mist. The pole carries six lanterns in a row, some round and some tall, with a thin string of red tassels, and the scarf at his neck is a red-and-yellow check from some lakeside village; the clay cup in his hand is chipped, and the fishing huts behind him stand on stilts over the grey water. Expression: a flushed, loose grin with bleary, merry eyes and a slack, easy mouth.

people.imagined: The ink-maker, soot-black to the elbow with a white stripe where the sleeve ends, stares at the viewer's hands without moving her eyes. She trusts nobody near the kiln.
people.subject: The moment: in a kiln hut she stares fixedly at the viewer's hands, never at the face, suspicious; she trusts nobody near the kiln. Face: most important, her bare forearms are soot-black to the elbow with a sharp white stripe exactly where the sleeve ends, as if she wore black gloves to the elbow, and her unblinking eyes are locked low on the hands. It is a gaunt, hard, narrow face of about fifty-five, ash-grey and dusted with soot, with pale unblinking eyes, thin black eyebrows, a sharp thin nose and a thin cruel mouth. Hair: black with a white streak, tied tight in a bun with a charcoal-black cord. Body: tall, thin and rigid. Clothing: an undyed linen robe, immaculate at the shoulders with the sleeves shoved up to the elbow, a dark grey sash and a leather apron. Hands and objects: held out in front, black to the elbow, one holding a short soot-black bar of ink; a faint grey-green soot haze. Background: a windowless stone hut with dark beams and an orange kiln door. Light: orange kiln glow from the lower left, throwing hard shadows. Expression: reclusive and cruel, a cold, paranoid watchfulness in the fixed stare and the thin mouth.

people.imagined: The head's only disciple holds her breath as she writes a plain ward in a single stroke. A scatter of ink dots freckles her cheek.
people.subject: The moment: at a writing table she holds her breath with cheeks slightly puffed, a brush poised over a clean sheet, concentrating on a plain ward to be written in a single stroke. Face: most important, a scatter of ink-dot freckles across her left cheek, small black dots as if flicked from a brush, and cheeks puffed from the held breath. It is a neat, round, earnest face of twenty, fair, with dark attentive eyes, straight neat brows, a small nose and lips pressed together. Hair: black, in a smooth bun pinned with a plain bone pin shaped like a brush. Body: slight, upright and stiff with concentration. Clothing: a clean undyed linen robe with the pine-green sash of the head's disciple, and ink-stained cuffs. Hands and objects: a brush held vertically in her slim fingers above a spotless sheet of resin-pale paper; a faint green hint at the brush tip. The brush hairs are fine and black, wet with ink at the very tip. Background: a blurred window and stacked paper, quiet and bare. Light: soft, even light from the upper left, falling on the cheek and the pale sheet. The light is clean and shadowless on her bent head. Expression: diligent and honest, a careful, anxious seriousness, the held breath of a girl who will not blot the line.

people.imagined: A harbourmaster's grandson with wind-bitten ears and ink under the nails, writing a ward of his own against a lantern-taker. He looks up with fierce eyes.
people.subject: The moment: seated drafting, he looks up fiercely, brush in hand, jaw clenched with a private grievance. Face, most important: ears red and chapped, wind-bitten at the rims, and black ink under every fingernail on the brush hand. A lean, hard, handsome face of twenty-two; weathered pale skin; storm-grey eyes; thick straight brows; a strong nose; a firm mouth. Hair: dark brown, short, tousled. Body: strong, wiry. Clothing: a clean undyed linen robe, a pine-green inner-gate sash, a blue sailor's knotted cord at the wrist. Hands: a brush gripped hard over a sheet showing a wall-like block pattern without writing. Background: a blurred lamp-lit desk and a lake window. Light: cool pale light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue ice hint at the page. His chapped red ears show beneath the cropped hair, the ink under his fingernails is a thin black crescent on each, the knotted blue cord at his wrist is a sailor's bracelet, and the page before him carries a bold block of wall-like strokes; the lamp is lit and the lake window is dark. His jaw is set and a muscle shows at the hinge; his collar is open a finger's width and his hair is tousled by wind. Expression: fierce eyes lifted from the page and a clenched jaw, brows low over a private grievance.

people.imagined: A third-year presser, hands soft from pulp, with a bark curl in her hair, still without a stroke and content with it.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a paper press with her hands held out palms up, she smiles content, a curl of birch bark caught in her hair, still without a stroke of her own and happy with it. Face: most important, palms puffy, pale and pulp-soft, wrinkled and white like a washerwoman's, held out toward the viewer, and a curl of white bark stuck in her hair above one ear. It is a round, sweet, ruddy face of seventeen, warm in tone and a little pink in the plump cheeks, with calm brown eyes, soft straight brows, a snub nose and a placid smile. Hair: brown, in a thick braid worn over one shoulder. Body: small and sturdy. Clothing: a clean undyed linen robe with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and cuffs damp, flecks of bark pulp dried on the forearm, an outer-gate grey sash and a pale apron. Hands and objects: both palms up, soft and pale; a faint green mist rises from the pulp. Background: the pressing table with stacked sheets and weighted boards, and paper sheets hanging in a yard. Light: soft cool light from the upper left, falling on her round cheeks. Expression: a content, soft smile and peaceful, unambitious eyes, a bark curl in her hair.

people.imagined: A north-shore boy talks in his shore dialect, feet never still, pocketing a village's silver and swearing it came up short.
people.subject: The moment: talking quickly and earnestly with spread hands, he shifts from foot to foot on the shingle, swearing a village's silver came up short while a fat purse bulges at his coat. Face: most important, an open mouth in mid-patter and a leather coin purse stuffed visibly at the breast of his coat, swollen with coins. It is a sharp, freckled, tanned face of nineteen, with bright shifting brown eyes, thin arched brows, a pointed nose and a smooth grin. Hair: sandy brown, sticking up, tied with a fisher's cord. Body: lean and always in motion, feet never still. Clothing: a clean undyed linen robe cut short, a north-shore blue scarf with a white fish pattern round the neck, and a grey outer-gate sash. Hands and objects: both hands open and spread as in a plea, rough from nets; a faint blue-grey mist in the air. Background: a blurred shore with boats bobbing at their moorings under a bright sky. Light: bright light from the upper left, hard on the water behind him. Expression: gregarious and fickle, greedy, an earnest, practised smile that does not reach the shifting eyes, the look of a boy who is sure he is persuasive.

people.imagined: She sits by a kiln all night without sleeping, dark-ringed eyes never drooping, a small burn scar on her wrist. She looks at the viewer steadily.
people.subject: The moment: sitting upright by a kiln glow at night, she stares steadily without blinking, awake all night as she always is. Face: most important, deep dark rings under wide, wakeful eyes, purple-grey, and a small glossy pale burn scar the size of a coin on the inside of her wrist, held up near her chin. It is a thin, serious face of eighteen, pale, with very dark eyes, straight dark brows, a small nose and a closed mouth. Hair: black, in a plain tail tied with a charcoal cord. Body: slim and straight-backed. Clothing: a clean undyed linen robe with the sleeves tied back, a pine-green inner-gate sash, and a grey apron. Hands and objects: one wrist lifted to show the scar, the other hand holding a cold ink stick; a faint soot-grey green haze drifts near it. Her knuckles are pale on the ink stick, and she has not moved in an hour. Background: a dark hut with the orange mouth of a kiln, throwing a soft glow on her chin. Light: orange kiln light from the lower left, the rest in deep shadow. The glow flickers faintly in her wide eyes. Expression: calm and cautious, loyal, a patient unblinking look that does not give way to sleep.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the age she made the Lantern Ward: small and stern, pine resin in her white hair, quill-callused fingers.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded like old silk, of the founder at the age she made the Lantern Ward, a small stern woman holding a brush upright and looking directly out. Face: most important, pine resin glinting in her white hair like amber beads. It is a small, hard, lined face of about fifty-five, pale, with sharp dark eyes, thin white brows, a narrow nose and a tight, set mouth. Hair: white, in a high coil threaded with four or five amber resin drops, each the size of a pea and glowing. Body: small, upright and spare. Clothing: an old-style undyed linen robe of fine cloth with a grey-green collar and ink-dark cuffs, and a plain cord at the waist. Hands and objects: every finger shows a hard yellow quill-callus as it grips a slim brush held upright; a faint pale green tint hovers round the brush. Background: a dim pine trunk and a faint lantern, soft as seen through a veil. Light: a soft pale glow from the upper left; the whole picture faded, soft-edged and yellowed like an old silk painting, the edges darkened. Expression: a severe, steady gaze with a firm mouth and a hidden softness around the eyes, faded like old silk.
